svg.text: Your computer - Python app (Gradio UI at localhost:7860, data/ folder)
Badges like :9003 on the left show
which service a step calls. Key in .env only.
Removing a file deletes its pages,
chunks and vectors from all 3 indexes.
No evidence / invalid citations -> "not in the course materials". A service that is down is skipped with a warning;
if the LLM is down, the closest pages are still shown.
Feedback shows correct option, explanation, document + slide/page, the quoted excerpt, and the slide image.
Stored locally: data/library.json, data/docs/<id>/pages/*.png, chunks.json, data/chroma/ (all git-ignored).
